prompt:
Paint one game-map kit piece in Heavenprint: hand-painted gouache and ink with broken, directional brush strokes, selective dry-brush scumbling, restrained hatching and warm ivory accents, the same hand as the attached kit pieces, but simplified and bold so it reads at 64 px. Straight overhead view, no perspective tilt, no horizon. Flat, even top light with one consistent soft highlight from the upper left on edges and tops; NO cast shadow, NO drop shadow, NO ground contact shadow, NO glow or bloom spilling outside the object (a lamp, a seam or the flecks the piece names may be lit within the object's own shape, never as a halo). Scale: one tile = 1.5 m = 256 px; a crate is about a metre (about 170 px), a standing person's footprint about a third of a tile. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signs with writing, no logos, no figures, no creatures, no UI, no frame, no border, no watermark. Everything is invented. For a sprite: transparent background (PNG with alpha), the object centred inside an 80% safe box of a 256 x 256 px canvas, crisp clean edges, no halo, nothing touching the canvas edge. For a ground texture: a seamless tileable square texture, 1024 x 1024 px, straight top-down, the left and right edges match and the top and bottom edges match when repeated, flat even lighting, no vignette, no border, no landmark that would show as a repeat, no objects on it, even mid-dark value with gentle low-contrast variation. The piece:
Setting: ahoc, a tired, well-kept containment base. A seamless tileable ground, 1024 x 1024, straight top-down: scuffed ceramic-grey floor plates with bolted seams every half tile (every 128 px) and two faint worn walking lanes of slightly paler wear running top to bottom. To fix the old seam: every lane, seam line and bolt row must be placed so that it meets its own continuation exactly at the left edge and the right edge and at the top edge and the bottom edge, with the overall brightness the same all the way across (no lighter or darker vertical band near either edge, no vignette, no stripe that ends at the border). Calm, even mid-dark grey with low-contrast scuffs and a few dull rust-red paint ghosts no bigger than a bolt. No letters, no stencil text, no objects. Avoid: a single large stain or a landmark that would show as a repeat, a bright seam line, a gradient across the tile.
One fully opaque square tile. Wrap geometry and lighting toroidally, exactly match opposite edges. No picture frame or margin.
